decisions: spicy-regs 66 (publish stated submitter contact fields) and 67 (native types)

tables.name: document_attributes
tables.grain: One row per Regulations.gov document: the attributes the thin documents table does not carry.

columns.name: document_id
columns.description: The document's id; its API record is https://api.regulations.gov/v4/documents/{document_id}.

columns.name: address1
columns.description: The submitter's street address, first line, as stated.

columns.name: address2
columns.description: The submitter's street address, second line, as stated.

columns.name: allow_late_comments
columns.description: Whether the agency accepts comments after the period closes.

columns.name: author_date
columns.description: When the document was written (labelled “Author/ Document Date”), a UTC instant.

columns.name: authors
columns.description: The document's authors, people or organizations, in the publisher's order; almost all on Supporting & Related Material.

columns.name: category
columns.description: The submitter's sector category the agency assigns; 38 values.

columns.name: cfr_part
columns.description: The CFR parts the document affects, free text as stated.

columns.name: city
columns.description: The submitter's city.

columns.name: comment
columns.description: The record's comment text as stated, markup included.

columns.name: country
columns.description: The submitter's country.

columns.name: display_properties_json
columns.description: The agency's labels for this record's fields: a JSON array of {label, name, tooltip}, name being the attribute it labels; json_column spelling.

columns.name: doc_abstract
columns.description: The document's abstract or summary.

columns.name: effective_date
columns.description: When the action takes effect, a UTC instant.

columns.name: exhibit_location
columns.description: Where a physical exhibit is held.

columns.name: exhibit_type
columns.description: The exhibit's type.

columns.name: fax
columns.description: The submitter's fax number.

columns.name: field1
columns.description: An agency-defined field; its meaning is the record's display_properties_json label (“Answer Date”, “XRIN”, “RTID”, …).

columns.name: field2
columns.description: An agency-defined field; its meaning is the record's display_properties_json label (“File Date” on all but one).

columns.name: first_name
columns.description: The submitter's given name.

columns.name: fr_vol_num
columns.description: The Federal Register volume or citation, free text as stated.

columns.name: gov_agency
columns.description: The government body that submitted the document.

columns.name: gov_agency_type
columns.description: That body's level: Federal, State, Local, Tribal, Regional, U.S. House of Representatives or U.S. Senate.

columns.name: implementation_date
columns.description: The implementation or service date, a UTC instant.

columns.name: last_name
columns.description: The submitter's family name.

columns.name: legacy_id
columns.description: The record's id in a predecessor system (“Document Legacy ID”, “Legacy Exhibit Number”, …).

columns.name: media
columns.description: How the document arrived: Electronic, Paper, … (spellings vary).

columns.name: object_id
columns.description: The publisher's internal object handle.

columns.name: omb_approval
columns.description: An OMB control number, as stated.

columns.name: open_for_comment
columns.description: Whether the document was open for comment when captured; an observation, not a live status.

columns.name: organization
columns.description: The organization the author or submitter names.

columns.name: original_document_id
columns.description: The id of the document this one derives from; the empty string on 368,375 records.

columns.name: page_count
columns.description: Pages in the content file.

columns.name: postmark_date
columns.description: The postmark date (often labelled “Answer Date”), a UTC instant.

columns.name: receive_date
columns.description: When the agency received the document, a UTC instant.

columns.name: reg_writer_instruction
columns.description: Agency notes (labelled “Old Submitter” on 61,052).

columns.name: restrict_reason
columns.description: Why access is restricted, free text.

columns.name: restrict_reason_type
columns.description: The restriction's kind: Copyrighted, Confidential Business Information, Personally Identifiable Information or Other.

columns.name: source_citation
columns.description: The source publication's citation.

columns.name: start_end_page
columns.description: The Federal Register start and end pages, as stated.

columns.name: state_province_region
columns.description: The submitter's state, province or region.

columns.name: subject
columns.description: The subject line.

columns.name: submitter_rep
columns.description: The name of the submitter's representative.

columns.name: subtype
columns.description: The agency's subtype: Correspondence, Report, Decision, … (823 values).

columns.name: topics
columns.description: The publisher's topics, in its order.

columns.name: tracking_nbr
columns.description: The portal's tracking number.

columns.name: within_comment_period
columns.description: Whether the document arrived within the comment period, when stated.

columns.name: zip
columns.description: The submitter's postal code.

tables.name: docket_attributes
tables.grain: One row per Regulations.gov docket: the attributes the thin dockets table does not carry.

columns.name: docket_id
columns.description: The docket's id; its API record is https://api.regulations.gov/v4/dockets/{docket_id}.

columns.name: category
columns.description: The docket's status (labelled “Disposition”): Pending, Closed and others.

columns.name: display_properties_json
columns.description: The agency's labels for this docket's fields: a JSON array of {label, name, tooltip}; [] on 64,859; json_column spelling.

columns.name: effective_date
columns.description: Mostly the docket's close date (labelled “Docket Close Date” on 13,111), a UTC instant.

columns.name: field1
columns.description: An agency-defined field (“Related Docket's RIN”, “Related To”, …); see display_properties_json.

columns.name: field2
columns.description: An agency-defined field (“Docket Status” on 59,872); see display_properties_json.

columns.name: generic
columns.description: An agency program code (“Docket Item Code”, “Location”, “Program Area”).

columns.name: keywords
columns.description: The docket's keywords, in the publisher's order.

columns.name: legacy_id
columns.description: The docket's id in a predecessor system.

columns.name: object_id
columns.description: The publisher's internal object handle.

columns.name: organization
columns.description: Labelled “Pre-EDOCKET ID” on 3,980 and “Organization” on 3,766; see display_properties_json.

columns.name: petition_nbr
columns.description: A petition number.

columns.name: program
columns.description: The program office (labelled “Center” on 64,910).

columns.name: short_title
columns.description: A short title (labelled “Action Office” on 13,262).

columns.name: sub_type
columns.description: The agency's docket subtype; 411 values.

columns.name: sub_type2
columns.description: A second docket subtype level.
